organization.name_ja: ソニーネットワークコミュニケーションズ株式会社

affected.note: Sum of 2,141,986 So-net members and 443,495 plala (S course) members, current and those who left in March 2026 or later, whose details were held in the So-net member database. Passwords of about 54,000 So-net mail addresses (free mail, A-Box, VAIO mail, PostPet) were also leaked and reset, and bank account details of 16 cases leaked. Member login passwords and credit card data were not leaked.

summary.en: Sony Network Communications confirmed on 2026-10-23 that a third party had accessed the So-net member database on 2026-10-19, and stopped the affected server. It announced that names, phone numbers, email addresses, birthdates and other details of 2,141,986 So-net members and 443,495 plala (S course) members had leaked, along with passwords for some So-net mail accounts.
summary.ja: ソニーネットワークコミュニケーションズは、2026年10月19日にSo-net会員データベースへ第三者による不正アクセスがあったことを10月23日に確認し、該当サーバーを停止した。So-net会員2,141,986名とぷらら（Sコース）会員443,495名の氏名、電話番号、メールアドレス、生年月日などのほか、一部のSo-netメールアカウントのパスワードが漏洩したと発表した。
